question: Which of the following shooters has NOT won a medal in the Olympics ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jitu Rai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jitu Rai** is an accomplished Indian shooter but has not won an Olympic medal.
 
• **Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** won a silver medal in Men's Double Trap at the 2004 Athens Olympics.
